name: Zyra Browser
description: Chat with Zyra beside your current tab. Use your connected browser from Zyra Desktop.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:
content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' blob: data: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; media-src 'self' blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; worker-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'
